guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile encountered an error during the Conda environment creation step due to 'Terms of Service' acceptance requirements for channels. The error message suggests using 'conda tos accept --override-channels --channel <channel_url>' to accept the Terms of Service for the listed channels. To resolve the issue, modify the Dockerfile to include the following commands before creating the Conda environment: 

1. Add the necessary 'conda tos accept' commands:
   ```bash
   RUN conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main && 
       conda tos accept --override-channels --channel https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r
   ```

2. Ensure these commands are placed before the existing `conda create -n testbed python=3.8 -y` line to prevent errors.

This change will allow the environment setup to proceed without failing due to Terms of Service acceptance issues.
